calls.title: Contextual Bandit Code Review
calls.summary: The team aimed to simplify data models by separating experiment rules from Contextual Bandit rules, enhancing clarity and avoiding legacy baggage. A hard cap of 14 context IDs was confirmed to manage complexity. Discussions included ensuring SDK payload generation is halted until full support is ready, as it could break existing functionalities. API adjustments are necessary to return contextual conditions alongside leaf weights, addressing frontend issues and legacy metrics for cleanup. Participants emphasized a cautious, phased rollout strategy to mitigate risks associated with incomplete features while prioritizing updates to improve type safety and separation of concerns in the implemented models.
calls.keywords: Contextual Bandit, Snapshot Model, Feature Rules, SDK Payload, Data Model, Experiment Revision
